consequential_defects: A171, A173 and A194 phrase the unsent next action as 'Draft outreach' despite no-contact/closed-policy/consent-review dispositions; an operator scanning prose could prepare contact for a barred account (consent hold on A173, Restricted-Zone on A194).

Day-0 terminal units A209, A213, A218, A231 and A233 use follow-up triggers that presuppose reviewing a customer 'response' although nothing was sent and no follow-up is permitted; the same 'response' phrasing recurs across the A161–A240 segment for never-sent drafts.
evidence: Full spot-check of all 240 units against the frozen policy finds dispositions, action types, follow-up days and claim codes correct, including fit=70 boundaries (A046, A103, A160, A217 qualify) and all eight consent holds mapped to hold/consent-review/no-contact/day 0 (A023, A053, A083, A113, A143, A173, A213, A233).

All eight Restricted-Zone and all eight sub-20-employee accounts are disqualify/closed-policy/no-contact/day 0, with evidence-only claim codes exactly where regulated=true (e.g. A014, A091, A098, A231) and standard elsewhere.
Every unit cites employees, fit_score, intent, region and consent_hold, names its exact SIG identifier in the next action, and marks the action unsent; no send, meeting or customer fact is asserted.
Uncertainty notes are uniform and honest ('fields from fictional intake only', 'no customer contact', 'no external verification performed'), correctly scoping confidence to the frozen dossier.

Follow-up triggers give observable resume conditions (day-elapsed or new-signal on the exact SIG id), making each unit individually ready for a native review surface, though no consolidated aggregate or native artifact accompanies the flat array.
Evidence strings alternate lowercase and capitalised booleans ('true'/'True') between segments (e.g. A041–A080, A121–A160), a minor parsing-consistency inconsistency.

worst_unit.defect: Consent-hold/no-contact account whose unsent next action is worded 'Draft outreach referencing SIG-173-CAPACITY', contradicting its consent-review disposition.
